niche: connected TV and streaming advertising agency
prompt_text: What is the best connected TV advertising agency?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” connected TV (CTV) advertising agency for everyone — the right choice depends on your goals, budget, geography, creative needs and whether you want programmatic buying, direct deals or fully integrated creative + media services.

Quick questions to help me recommend one for you:
- Where do you want to run ads (US, EMEA, APAC)?
- What’s your monthly/total budget range?
- Main objective: brand awareness, direct-response (sales/leads), foot-traffic, app installs?
- Do you need creative production for 30–60s CTV spots or only media buying/optimization?
- Do you prefer programmatic DSP buys or publisher/platform-direct placements (Roku, Samsung Ads, Hulu, etc.)?

How to pick the best agency (short checklist)
- Platform relationships: direct access to Roku, Samsung, Hulu, Vizio, Amazon Fire TV, publishers
- Programmatic expertise: DSP partners, audience targeting, frequency controls
- Measurement & verification: Nielsen/Comscore, VideoAmp, iSpot, Innovid or similar for outcomes and viewability
- Creative capabilities: CTV-specific creative and dynamic/adaptive creative experience
- Transparency & reporting: clear KPIs, unified cross-screen measurement, billing
- Fraud & brand safety controls: PMP, whitelist/blacklist, invalid traffic controls
- Case studies in your vertical and similar budgets

Agencies/partners commonly recommended (by use case)
- Large/full-service + scale (brand campaigns, global buys): GroupM (Mindshare/MediaCom/Wavemaker), OMD (Omnicom), Starcom/Performics (Publicis), Carat (Dentsu), Initiative (IPG). Good when you need global scale, TV + digital integration and negotiated access.
- Performance-focused / mid-market (direct response, e-commerce): Tinuiti, Jellyfish, 3Q Digital, Independent shops that specialize in performance CTV and measurement.
- CTV/OTT specialists & programmatic buying partners: Amobee, The Trade Desk (DSP — not an agency but essential buying platform), Tremor/Magnite (supply-side partners), Roku OneView and Samsung Ads (platform buys).
- Creative & dynamic CTV production: Innovid, R/GA, Wieden+Kennedy and specialist creative houses that produce CTV-format, interactive and dynamic ads.
- Measurement & analytics partners (often work alongside agencies): Nielsen Digital Ad Ratings, VideoAmp, iSpot.tv, Comscore, Innovid — choose agencies that integrate these.

Practical next steps
1. Tell me the answers to the clarifying questions above and I’ll recommend 2–3 agencies/partners tailored to your needs (and a suggested short RFP).
2. If you already have a short list, I can help draft questions to evaluate them (platform access, reporting cadence, sample KPIs, test plan, pricing).

If you give me region, budget and main objective I’ll recommend specific agencies and why each fits.
